250-779-1479-5226-8338.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5226-8338.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5226-8338.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

574-2692-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, either putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and granting them vigilance until end of turn or creating a 2/2 white Cat Beast creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-2692-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2921-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
2921-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat from step 3.
2921-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

1339-2835-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1651-4231-4732-5261-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1651-4231-4732-5261-6753.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

4499-4826-7898.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts.
4499-4826-7898.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Smaug.
When Smaug enters, its first ability triggers, creating a number of Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

413-4871-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
When the Goblin, Orc or Army enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat

129-270-1978-5793.description:
Activate Hedron Archive by tapping it, adding two mana.
Kinnan triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Hedron Archive which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

3490-5231-6996-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6996-7818.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

215-850-1251.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-1251.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1329-6766-7340-7681.description:
If Sewer-veillance Cam is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Sewer-veillance Cam.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Technodrome.
Activate Sewer-veillance Cam by tapping it, adding {U} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Technodrome by tapping it and sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam, causing you to draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on Technodrome.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

323-2173-4496-5220.description:
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-2445-5189-7426.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
2034-2445-5189-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Branching Evolution.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

206-2440-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
206-2440-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

1806-2060-2438-4772-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2267-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

620-1594-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-1594-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

549-1978-2436.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat

997-1445-4871-6351.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
997-1445-4871-6351.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2633-2871-6259.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}.
Urabrask triggers, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve Seething Anger.
Repeat.

1849-2105-3204-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1849-2105-3204-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

440-1339-2034-2275.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-2275.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Shabraz trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shabraz trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2561-4365-4559.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Metalwork Colossus, creating two Food tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Foods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

428-3769-3908-5096.description:

Blim triggers, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Spark Double triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

997-2178-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
997-2178-5470.description:

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

498-2050-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Arbor Elf.
Elvish Guidance attached to a Forest you control.
Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three Elves.
498-2050-5200.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the Forest that has Elvish Guidance attached.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Elvish Guidance triggers, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Arbor Elf.

618-4242-4499-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping itself, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing copy of Su-Chi, adding {R}.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Kiki-Jiki.
Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1556-2608-4013.description:
Tap Ruins, add {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Use {2}{C} of that to use Eldrazi Displacer's ability, blinking Derevi.
Derevi enters, untapping Ruins.
Repeat.
